title: Dated end-of-sale and end-of-life notices for Analyzer, Shift, Office365Mon, CIEM, SecureAgent and ZAB hardware

prose.text: Each notice below is what it says on its announcement date; none states the product's current status {{gap:current-status}}.

prose.label: Microsoft 365 and cloud identity.
prose.text: {{office365mon}} {{ciem}} ZPC has its own EOS and EOL notice in [[portfolio.cloud-protection]].

prose.label: Mobile agents and hardware.
prose.text: {{secureagent-ios}} {{secureagent-android}} It is dated after its own EOS date {{divergence:secureagent-android-notice-period}}. {{zab-hardware}}

analyzer.statement: The notice dated December 5, 2023 gives Zscaler Analyzer an EOS date of February 28, 2024 and an EOL date of February 28, 2025, and says to plan a migration to Digital Experience (ZDX).

quotes: | February 28, 2024 | February 28, 2025 |
new downloads for the Zscaler Analyzer tool and functionality of the related zmtr.zscaler.com website will not be available
you must plan a migration to Digital Experience (ZDX)
Announcement date: December 5, 2023

shift.statement: The notice dated August 1, 2022 gives Zscaler Shift (Zscaler Intelligent Routing for Guest Wi-Fi Protection) an EOS date of November 1, 2022 and an EOL date of November 1, 2024, and suggests a migration plan to ZIA.

quotes: | November 1, 2022 | November 1, 2024 |
Zscaler Shift (also known as Zscaler Intelligent Routing for Guest Wi-Fi Protection)
Existing contracts will not be renewed beyond the EOL date.
you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
Announcement date: August 1, 2022

office365mon.statement: The notice dated July 20, 2022 gives Zscaler Office365Mon an EOS date of October 20, 2022 and an EOL date of October 20, 2023, and suggests migration to ZDX for Microsoft 365.

quotes: | October 20, 2022 | October 20, 2023 |
subscriptions for Office365Mon will not be available for purchase
you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for Microsoft 365
Announcement date: July 20, 2022

ciem.statement: The notice dated July 18, 2022 gives Zscaler Cloud Identity Entitlement Management (CIEM) an EOS date of October 18, 2022 and an EOL date of October 18, 2023, and says ZPC is available to CIEM customers at no extra charge for the remainder of the subscription period.

quotes: | October 18, 2022 | October 18, 2023 |
licenses for new CIEM subscriptions will not be available for purchase
The ZPC service is now available for CIEM customers with no extra charge for the remainder of the subscription period.
Announcement date: July 18, 2022

secureagent-ios.statement: The notice dated July 20, 2017 gives Zscaler SecureAgent for iOS an EOS date of March 1, 2017 and an EOL date of November 30, 2017, and requires migration to Client Connector for iOS for deployments using IPSec tunnels.

quotes: | March 1, 2017 | November 30, 2017 |
SecureAgent on iOS uses an on-demand IPSec VPN tunnel as its primary method
If you are using SecureAgent on iOS devices with IPSec tunnels, you must plan a migration to Zscaler Client Connector for iOS.
Announcement date: July 20, 2017

secureagent-android.statement: The notice dated August 6, 2018 gives Zscaler SecureAgent for Android an EOS date of August 1, 2018 and an EOL date of March 1, 2019, and requires migration to Client Connector for Android by March 1, 2019.

quotes: | August 1, 2018 | March 1, 2019 |
You must migrate to Zscaler Client Connector on Android by March 1, 2019
Announcement date: August 6, 2018

zab-hardware.statement: The notice dated December 20, 2017 says Zscaler would no longer support Zscaler Authentication Bridge (ZAB) hardware as of March 1, 2019, with support permanently terminated after March 31, 2019, and that ZAB functionality is available as software.

quotes: Zscaler will no longer support the Zscaler Authentication Bridge (ZAB) hardware as of March 1, 2019.
Support for the ZAB hardware will be permanently terminated after March 31, 2019.
The ZAB functionality is now available via software.
Announcement date: December 20, 2017

current-status.title: Current status of a product named in an EOS/EOL notice
current-status.detail: Each notice gives dates as of its announcement date. The captured Supported Versions page (supported-versions-20260909.json) names none of Analyzer, Shift, Office365Mon, CIEM or SecureAgent, so it does not say whether they are now past EOS or EOL beyond the notice dates.

secureagent-android-notice-period.summary: The EOS and EOL Policy, effective August 1st, 2017, requires Zscaler notification at least 60 days before EOS for Software Products, while the SecureAgent for Android notice has announcement date August 6, 2018 and EOS date August 1, 2018.

positions.says: Zscaler notifies at least 60 days before EOS for Software Products.

quotes: Zscaler notification at least 60 days before EOS
This policy is effective as of August 1st, 2017.

positions.says: The SecureAgent for Android notice was announced August 6, 2018 for an EOS date of August 1, 2018.

quotes: | August 1, 2018 | March 1, 2019 |
Announcement date: August 6, 2018

secureagent-android-notice-period.impact: Neither page says whether the policy applied to SecureAgent or whether earlier notice was given elsewhere, so the notice dates cannot be read as proof the 60-day period was met or waived.
